title: Measured Joules, Learned Routes: Learning to Route for Energy-Efficient LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2609.23085v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI systems are creating rapidly growing inference energy demands as model sizes grow and reasoning trajectories extend. While in practice, many queries do not require the capabilities of the largest available model, and routinely directing such queries to a high-capability model can introduce unnecessary, considerable computation and energy consumption. In this paper, we investigate whether adaptive routing across a heterogeneous pool of LLMs can reduce this energy burden without substantially compromising task performance. We design a language-model-based router that reads in each query and selects an answer model from a fixed candidate pool. The candidate models are first profiled through an offline tournament that records their correctness, latency, power, and GPU energy for each query. translated_title: 实测焦耳，习得路由：面向高能效大语言模型服务的路由学习
translated_abstract: 随着模型规模不断增长和推理轨迹不断延长，大语言模型（LLM）与智能体AI系统正带来快速增长的推理能耗需求。然而在实践中，许多查询并不需要最大可用模型所具备的能力，而将此类查询常规地导向高能力模型会引入不必要的大量计算与能量消耗。本文研究了在异构LLM池中进行自适应路由是否能够在不明显损害任务性能的前提下降低这一能量负担。我们设计了一个基于语言模型的路由器，它读取每个查询并从固定的候选模型池中选择一个回答模型。候选模型首先通过离线锦标赛进行性能剖析，记录其针对每个查询的正确率、延迟、功耗和GPU能耗。利用这些实测数据，路由器先通过监督微调进行训练，随后再采用群组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行训练。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于实测能耗数据的LLM路由器，通过离线锦标赛测量候选模型的正确率、延迟、功耗与GPU能耗，并采用监督微调结合群组相对策略优化进行训练，从而在异构模型池间自适应选择模型，在不显著牺牲任务性能的情况下有效降低大语言模型推理的能耗。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an LLM router trained on measured energy data—profiling candidate models' correctness, latency, power, and GPU energy through an offline tournament, then trained via supervised fine-tuning and group relative policy optimization—to adaptively select models from a heterogeneous pool, reducing LLM inference energy consumption without substantially compromising task performance.
